dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple circular and sub-circular high-contrast perimeters exhibit sharp transitions from low-intensity dark exterior pixels to high-intensity white/cream boundaries. These perimeters frequently enclose low-intensity interior cores, forming distinct 'O' shaped structures with irregular, non-uniform edge thicknesses.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, irregular high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated in the anterior cervical region and along the inferior lateral margin. A continuous low-intensity pixel zone with minimal internal variance is localized along the superior dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central lateral field form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of four smaller annuli located posteriorly forms a distorted rectangular geometric relationship.
